_comment: MCP resource spec for #53 PM Horoscope. Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft — MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026) is young and may have changed; owner to validate against current docs before locking.

resource.name: PM Horoscope
resource.description: Daily reading based on twelve corpus-derived PM archetypes. Deterministic, no LLM call.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_read
tools.description: Returns today's PM horoscope reading for a chosen archetype. Deterministic, composed from date + archetype.

archetype.description: User's archetype, set once via quiz or direct pick.

date.description: ISO date. Defaults to today if omitted.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_quiz
tools.description: Returns the six-question archetype quiz. User answers map to one of twelve archetypes.

answers.description: Six integer answers, indices into each question's options.

next_archetype.description: Second-closest archetype, in case the user disagrees with the primary.

_open_questions: Validate `ui://` URI scheme against current MCP Apps spec.
Confirm `mimeType: text/html` is the right way to declare UI resource vs structured output.
Decide whether quiz state lives in the server (persistent across sessions) or in the host (cookie/local-storage).
